senses.gloss: (contr. of כַּלֵּה וָלֵךְ, v. כָּלָה) cease and turn!, go! Yeb. 44ᵃ כ׳ אצל שכמותך turn towards one corresponding to thine own age.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 22a:11">B. Mets. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ אצל יפות</he> go to better fruits (to take T’rumah from); <cite ref="Eruvin 71a:11">Erub. 71ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 164b:14">B. Bath. 164ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ מלשון וכ׳</he> turn away from this kind of slander. Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 2, ch. II <he>או כ׳ לדרך זו</he> or turn this way, i.e. I may argue thus; (<cite ref="Bava Batra 164b:14">ib.</cite> Emor, Par. 12, ch. XVII <he>או לכה וכ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 164b:14">Ib.</cite> Vayikra, Ḥobah, Par. 7, ch. XI <he>או כ׳ לך</he> (corr. acc.); a. e.
